units.source_text: 这亲王的父亲桐壶帝和母亲女御都早已逝世，

en.t: This prince's father, Emperor Kiritsubo, and his mother, the nyogo, had both died long ago,

units.source_text: 又没有显贵有力的保护人，因此从小不曾习得高深的学问。

en.t: and since he had no powerful protector of high rank, he had never acquired any deep learning from childhood.

units.source_text: 何况处世立身之道，教他何由得知呢？

en.t: Still less could he have learned how to conduct himself in the world and make his own way.

units.source_text: 在高贵人物之中，这位亲王特别娇生惯养，竟像女子一般。

en.t: Among people of noble birth, this prince had been especially pampered, almost like a woman.

units.source_text: 因此祖上传下来的宝物以及外祖父大臣给他的遗产，

en.t: Therefore the treasures handed down from his ancestors, as well as the inheritance given to him by his maternal grandfather the minister,

units.source_text: 虽然样样式式不计其数，却损失得影迹全无。

en.t: though countless in every kind and form, were lost until not a trace remained.

units.source_text: 只有珍贵的日常用品，现在留存的还很多。

en.t: Only many precious everyday furnishings still remain now.

units.source_text: 他也没有知心人来访问，生活寂寞无聊。

en.t: He also had no close friends who came to visit him, and his life was lonely and dull.

units.source_text: 便从雅乐寮乐师之类的人中选择音乐技能优越者，

en.t: So he chose those with outstanding musical skill from among the musicians of the Bureau of Court Music and similar people,

units.source_text: 召他们来，和他们专心研习闲情逸致的管弦之乐，

en.t: summoned them to him, and devoted himself with them to studying the elegant pleasures of wind and string music,
growing up in this way from childhood.

units.source_text: 因此在音乐方面具有非常优越的才能。

en.t: As a result, he possessed exceptionally outstanding talent in music.
